name: Apothecary Johaan
summary: In Brill, Apothecary Johaan works to develop a plague for the Forsaken. The Royal Apothecary Society and Lady Sylvanas have charged him with lethal experiments on local plants and animals.

sections.title: A Servant of the Society
sections.body: Apothecary Johaan works openly from Brill in Tirisfal Glades for the newly formed Royal Apothecary Society. Like his colleagues across Lordaeron, he follows direct orders to create biological and alchemical weapons. The Forsaken hope these weapons will secure their fragile future against the living and the Scourge alike.

sections.title: Brewing the New Plague
sections.body: Apothecary Johaan leads early field trials of the Society's New Plague. He uses materials from Tirisfal's corrupted wildlife and blighted farms, including darkhound blood, murloc scales, spider venom and stolen farm pumpkins. He tests the mixtures on living subjects, measures their potency and sends his findings south to Silverpine Forest.

faq.answer: Apothecary Johaan researches alchemy in Brill for the Royal Apothecary Society. He directs young Forsaken champions to gather vile reagents across Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Where can I find Apothecary Johaan?
faq.answer: You can find Apothecary Johaan outside in Brill, near the gallows and alchemical apparatus. The town lies just north of the Undercity in Tirisfal Glades.
Johaan is developing early strains of the New Plague. He tests biological agents and venomous extracts from Tirisfal's blighted fields and beasts.

faq.q: What does he do with the plague samples?
faq.answer: After mixing samples and assessing their lethality, Johaan sends couriers to deliver them to allied apothecaries in Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: What organization does Johaan belong to?
faq.answer: Johaan belongs to the Royal Apothecary Society, the alchemical guild that serves Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and the Forsaken in the Undercity.

faq.q: Why is he interested in the local farms?
faq.answer: Human farms such as the Solliden Farmstead and nearby pumpkin patches grow pumpkins that Johaan uses as raw reagents for experimental toxins.

angles.text: As an undead, you belong to the Forsaken cause Johaan's research serves. He develops weapons meant to secure a permanent homeland free of the Scourge and living threats.
As a member of the Horde, you may see how Johaan's deadly concoctions protect its foothold in the Eastern Kingdoms. Orcs and tauren might balk at alchemical blights.
